desc: Formalize the matching/parity characterization and the even-segment formula; use it to justify prefix/suffix decomposition for odd N.
Implement the complete Python solution with two heaps for even prefix/suffix scores, handling even and odd N, O(N log N), stdin/stdout, code delimiters.
Validate on samples and small brute-force/edge cases (N=2, all equal, odd/even, large values); sample tests passed.
